old_ingest_anomaly.conclusion: The old0.60497 anomaly did not reproduce: current standard0.99974, same-binary A/A1.00605. No large candidate-specific COMMIT wall stall appears now. A/A has only3pairs and old run lacked nested timers, so old root cause is unproven and cannot be declared permanently eliminated.

findings: Keep MVDB_ENABLE_BLOCK_QUANT_SCALE/MVDB_BLOCK_SCALE_SELECTIVE off by default. Correctness evidence passes, but gated-off fallback does not establish performance parity.

coordinate_dispersed128: whole-query ratios0.95951/0.95944, steady0.95863/0.95402, negative14/15 and12/15; all3seed and both orders negative, both programs2threads throughout. First requests slightly improve, so the regression is not first-query setup.

low16_100k: whole-query0.94013/0.93543, steady0.94058/0.93432, negative14/15 in both phases; all3seed and both orders negative; both programs2threads throughout. Lowdim gate eliminates local admission but not macro-enabled object/code-layout and common setup differences.

Positive special cases are real within this experiment: outlier1281.86658/1.86565, row_dispersed1281.87085/1.85902, high768_outlier1.36847/1.36117; all15 pairs improve each phase. Lifecycle ratios are only1.10472,1.08152,1.03580; do not substitute query ratios for whole-workload score.

Row-dispersed means scattered by insertion slot; norm sorting regroups outlier rows. It is not the coordinate-dispersed case, in which every row contains an outlier coordinate and every block remains contaminated.

Whole-request gate predictions: standard/gaussian/coordinate/low16 fail; outlier/row-dispersed have19712/20000 substantially fine rows(98.56%); high768 has3840/4096(93.75%). These are far from80% boundary and do not establish threshold optimality.

Quantized code budgets are1.28MB for10kx128,2.56MB for20kx128,3.145728MB for4096x768,1.6MB for100kx16; all fit4MiB code cap. No live payload or flat spill file appeared in any saved resource snapshot.

Dimension16 fails the constructor gate before local metadata reservation. Coordinate-dispersed has step2 in every block and fails both finer and selective predicates. Residual macro-enabled structs/initialization/destruction/loop dispatch and compiled layout remain different; these are possible mechanisms, not measured causal attribution.

Candidate RSS generally adds20KiB already after ingest before index construction; the same delta often remains after queries. A/A RSSdelta0. This is consistent with program/common-memory footprint, but cannot attribute query slowdown to cache/stack/instructions without assembly evidence.

Gaussian has3 policy mismatches across phases; same-policy sensitivity0.99285(first,13pairs)/0.99168(restart,14pairs). high768 has1 first-phase mismatch; same-policy14pairs still1.36977. No mismatch occurs in either persistent negative control.

The small same-binary A/A screen has first/restart query ratios1.00047/0.97818 and restart minimum0.94228, so it is not a precise universal noise estimate for other scenarios. The repeatable15pair negative controls must remain visible.
No production changes or new optimization version are proposed in this analysis. Prior negative data and this run raw positive/negative evidence remain intact; no official-score prediction.
